title: Teachers' Day Workshop, 2019
teaser: A full-day science workshop for about 60 teachers on Teachers' Day 2019, in collaboration with the Academy and ScienceUtsav, featuring hands-on experiments and sessions on pedagogy.
homepageMatter: On 12 September 2019 (Teachers' Day), tAcT organised a full-day science workshop in collaboration with the Academy and ScienceUtsav. About 60 science teachers from schools in and around Bengaluru participated in hands-on experiments and interactive lectures on pedagogy.
